title: Cobblemon PC Plus
description: Supercharge your PC with one scrollable list across all boxes, plus filters, favorite pinning, sorting, UI scaling, and type icons. Client-side PC storage enhancer for Cobblemon on NeoForge & Fabric.
body:
![Cobblemon PC Plus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/zPZ3SPik/images/226548c4c71cd4d54c8392fb5cacc47ac8d2e91c.png) ![Cobblemon PC Plus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/zPZ3SPik/images/ac16ff980323b52e06fd5fad1ada6de82b593d41.png) ![Cobblemon PC Plus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/zPZ3SPik/images/6633002f011177ff2d9196057ea5df2867b1b307.png) **Cobblemon PC Plus** turns the Cobblemon PC into a proper collection manager. Browse every box at once in a single scrollable **List view**, **filter** by type / gender / level / favorites, **favorite** and **sort** your Pokémon, and read **type icons** at a glance from a panel above the PC. > **Client-side** · **NeoForge & Fabric** · **works on any server** (no server install) · **plays nicely with other Cobblemon addons** ## What's New in 1.1.0 - 🪟 **Movable PC Plus window**: drag the panel anywhere, minimize it, or reset it. - 🔍 **Medium PC size**: a new 1.5× zoom step between Normal and Large. - ♂♀ **Gender symbols** in the Gender filter drop down, matching the Cobblemon PC symbols. _See the changelog for full version history._ *** ## Features ### List view: your whole collection at once Toggle the PC between the classic single-box view and a combined **List view** that merges every box into one continuous list. Scroll with the **mouse wheel**, a **draggable scrollbar**, or the **keyboard** (Page Up/Down, Home/End). The scrollbar and its frame are optional. The PC remembers whichever view you last used. ### Smart filters A terminal panel above the PC adds dropdown filters for **Type, Gender, Level, and Favorites**. They combine (AND) with each other _and_ with Cobblemon's built-in search box. You decide how non-matches are shown while filtering: the List view can **collapse** to just the matches or **fade** them in place, and the party panel can be **hidden** or **kept visible**. The **Gender** filter shows the **♂ / ♀** symbols beside each option, matching the PC's own preview. ### Movable terminal window The filter panel is a **draggable window**: grab its **"PC PLUS" titlebar** and move it anywhere on screen (it works expanded or collapsed, at every PC size, and always stays on-screen). **Minimize** it to just the titlebar to reclaim space, or **reset** it back to the default spot. It can optionally **remember where you put it** between sessions. > **Dragged it somewhere awkward?** Click the **⟲ reset** button on the titlebar, or set **`rememberTerminalPosition`** to **OFF**, then close and reopen the PC. ### Favorites Mark Pokémon as favorites with a **Mark Favorites** mode or the **star on the preview portrait**. Favorites get a gold star on their slot; you can also **filter to show only favorites** or **pin favorites to the top**. No new keybinds to clash with other mods. ### Sorting Sort the List view by **Level** or **Pokédex #**, ascending or descending (click a sort button to flip it), optionally keeping favorites first. Sorting only changes the **display order**; it never moves your Pokémon in storage. ### Type icons & dropdown styling A small **type icon** on each Pokémon slot (toggleable). The **Type filter dropdown** can also color type names by their type and show each type's icon. ### Adjustable PC size Scale the whole PC interface up — **Normal / Medium / Large / Extra Large** (1× / 1.5× / 2× / 3×) — when the default is too small to read comfortably. ![Cobblemon PC Plus - PC](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/zPZ3SPik/images/226548c4c71cd4d54c8392fb5cacc47ac8d2e91c.png) *** ## Upcoming Features More advanced features are planned for future updates. If there is a specific feature you would like to see, let us know! ## Configuration Options include the default view, type icons, Type-dropdown color/icons, favorites & sort defaults, how non-matches are shown while filtering (collapse/fade and party hide/show), the List-view scrollbar and frame, PC size, and whether the terminal window remembers its position. Your view, sort, and filter choices persist between sessions. * **NeoForge** — open **Mods → Cobblemon PC Plus → Config** in-game. * **Fabric** — edit `config/cobblemonpcplus.json` ### Fabric — `config/cobblemonpcplus.json` options Launch the game once and the file is created with every option at its default. Values must match **exactly** (case-sensitive); the **bold** value is the default. | Option | Values (**default** bold) | What it does | |---|---|---| | `showTypeIcons` | **`true`** / `false` | Type icon on each Pokémon slot | | `colorTypeNames` | `true` / **`false`** | Color type names in the Type dropdown | | `showTypeFilterIcons` | **`true`** / `false` | Show type icons in the Type dropdown | | `defaultView` | **`LIST_VIEW`** /
`BOX_VIEW` | View the PC opens in | | `showListScrollbar` | **`true`** / `false` | Draggable scrollbar in List view | | `showListFrame` | **`true`** / `false` | Frame around the List grid | | `startFiltersCollapsed` | `true` / **`false`** | Open with the filter panel collapsed | | `rememberTerminalPosition` | `true` / **`false`** | Remember the terminal window's dragged position between sessions | | `showFavoriteStars` | **`true`** / `false` | Gold star on favorited slots | | `defaultSort` | **`NONE`** /
`LEVEL` /
`DEX` | Default sort mode | | `defaultSortDescending` | `true` / **`false`** | Sort descending instead of ascending | | `defaultFavoritesFirst` | `true` / **`false`** | Pin favorites to the top | | `filterDisplay` | `COLLAPSE_PC_HIDE_PARTY` /
**`COLLAPSE_PC_FADE_PARTY`** /
`FADE_PC_HIDE_PARTY` /
`FADE_PC_FADE_PARTY` | How non-matches show while filtering | | `pcSize` | **`NORMAL`** /
`MEDIUM` /
`LARGE` /
`EXTRA_LARGE` | PC interface scale (1× / 1.5× / 2× / 3×) | ## Requirements * Minecraft **1.21.1** on **NeoForge** _or_ **Fabric** * **Cobblemon** 1.7.x (1.21.1) * **NeoForge:** Kotlin for Forge * **Fabric:** Fabric API (Cobblemon already bundles Fabric Language Kotlin) ## Installation Download the file that matches your loader — the **`-neoforge-`** jar for NeoForge or the **`-fabric-`** jar for Fabric — and drop it into your client's `mods` folder alongside Cobblemon (and Kotlin for Forge on NeoForge, or Fabric API on Fabric). **No server-side install needed** — it's purely client-side. ## Compatibility Works standalone with Cobblemon, alongside Cobblemon add-ons, or as part of large Cobblemon modpacks. ## Support Found a bug or have a suggestion? Leave a comment on this page. Feedback is welcome! ## License & Modpacks This project is protected under an All Rights Reserved license.
